notes_replace: The handwritten sheet number is 30. Part a) argues that the proposed F′ is a figure. It first computes its support and then separates the least-containing-element argument into x in |G|=|G′| and x outside |G|. Both cases end with the author’s “OK”; the second has an exclamation mark. Part b) replaces raffine with inserted subdivise and, after a cancelled attempt, restates a least-containing-element condition and an intersection-as-union-of-strata condition. No title or date appears.

The support calculation was checked conditionally (031-check-01): if F′=G′∪(F\setminus G), |G′|=|G| and |G|⊆|F|, then every point of |F| outside |G| belongs to some member of F that is not a member of G. Thus |F\setminus G| contains |F|\setminus|G|, and the displayed union has support |F|. These premises are carried from the stated construction; the calculation does not prove that F′ is a figure or verify every refinement axiom.

The first case announces “prouvons A⊂B” but its terminal A carries a small thick raised mark, preferred as a circle with bullet/star alternatives. That mark is retained: the mathematical target does not license erasing it. No complete proof check of the least-element or stratum arguments is claimed. The two cancelled signs in b) are inverted A forms, ∀, rather than the word Soit.

In the second case the blind audit resolves the dotted ending as “c’est lui plus petit él. de F”; le and any supplied qui est are excluded. After él. de F, the ink reads “et à fortiori de F\setminus G)” with a closing parenthesis but no opening parenthesis. The missing opener is not supplied for grammatical balance. H’s cf. définition and its reordered qui est are unsupported. The first three compressed élément forms retain a possible raised t; the fourth admits a terminal-free élém alternative. The two de-like groups in the cancelled lower line remain.

The isolated support equality retains = as preferred but now admits superset-with-bar because the short upper shaft hooks downward; the support conclusion does not decide its shape. The earlier cancelled relation prefers superset with equals as alternative. The slanted a un plus petit addition is marginal, inserted and subsequently cancelled, with = un plus petit as an alternative. The l’ens clause is also raised and is marked inserted within the cancellation. The final crossed script-R adjective retains R as preferred with Q/O alternatives and is replaced above by fermé dans F-prime. The state and placement of these additions are recorded separately from their uncertain words.

The blind audit adds a doubtful superset after the old B in case1; it also restores local uncertainty in opening i.e., cancelled contient, both cancelled évident occurrences, the lower cancelled raffine and the first de/des before strates. The repeated évident sequence and the later plain de before strates de G-prime remain. The live argument and its conditional support check are not strengthened by these visual decisions.
